data.one_liner: Extended Web Notifications API for Dart with action buttons and custom options.
data.what_it_does: Extends standard Dart web notifications to allow advanced customization such as action buttons, tags, custom icons, and interaction persistence. It handles service worker registration automatically out-of-the-box and provides streams for notification actions and dismissals.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application that requires interactive web notifications.
You need custom actions, tags, or persistent notifications on browsers.
avoid_when: Your application targets mobile or desktop native platforms instead of the web.
You are looking for a complete push notification service like Firebase Messaging.
strengths: Zero-setup service worker bundled as an asset automatically.
Full migration to package:web and WebAssembly support.
Supports interactive actions and notification streams.
weaknesses: Web-only package; does not support native mobile or desktop platforms.
Platform action limits vary based on browser and OS capabilities (e.g. macOS limits actions).
data.setup_notes: No manual service worker copying required anymore. The service worker is deployed automatically as a bundled asset.
